producing_session.source: User copied response of ChatGPT session attempting MCP-01; independent execution trace not present

independent_external.note: This only shows the server functioning from GitHub Actions, not ChatGPT host exposure.

reviewer_host.tool_inventory_method: Tool metadata enumeration in reviewer session, not producing-session tool trace

risk: A skills-only ChatGPT conversation may not acquire MCP actions just by having a valid portable mcp.json stored in a private plugin.
likely_causes_not_yet_proved: No separately registered ChatGPT MCP app/connector binding; no .app.json present in stored plugin.
Plugin may be installed but MCP connection not enabled or linked in ChatGPT.
Plan/workspace policy or interface may prevent custom MCP connections.
Conversation may not have loaded current plugin release despite saved account state.
officially_documented_path: In eligible ChatGPT environment, use Plugins > Add > Add custom MCP server, enter verified HTTPS endpoint, review risk disclosure, Create as plugin, inspect detected tools; use actual returned plugin_asdk_app ID for binding if supported.

next_acceptance.prerequisite: Registered supported MCP app is visible and enabled to user in ChatGPT; do not invent or use an unrelated app ID.
next_acceptance.evidence: Concrete host tool invocation/response with provenance; saved manifest and external CI alone are insufficient.

safe_behavior: Keep read-only registry, six skills, and stable 0.17 unchanged; do not attempt repeated archive uploads or fake tool results.
